en_title: GTA 6 Rakes in Over $750 Million in Preorders 2 Weeks Ahead of Release Date
cn_title: 《GTA6》距离发售还有2周，预购收入已超过7.5亿美元
opus_summary: Sensor Tower估计，截至11月3日，《GTA6》预购销量达771万份，金额约为7.51亿美元(约合人民币50亿元)，其中PlayStation占74%，XBOX占26%。游戏将于2026年11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX X|S，标准版售价80美元(约合人民币534元)，终极版售价100美元(约合人民币668元)。

paragraphs.en: Data compiled by analytics firm Sensor Tower estimates that GTA 6 has already raked in more than $750 million in preorders across both PlayStation 5 and Xbox.
paragraphs.cn: 分析公司Sensor Tower汇总的数据估计，《GTA6》在PS5和XBOX上的预购收入合计已超过7.5亿美元。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 launches in just two short weeks. It’s one of the most highly anticipated video game releases of all time and possibly the biggest pop culture phenomenon of this decade.
paragraphs.cn: 再过短短两周，《GTA6》就将发售。它是有史以来最受期待的电子游戏之一，也可能是本世纪20年代最重大的流行文化现象。

paragraphs.en: The hype for this particular entry is off the charts, and fans of Rockstar’s open-world action-adventure franchise are putting their money where their mouths are. According to data aggregated by Sensor Tower , Rockstar has already made three-quarters of the way to a billion dollars in preorders alone.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家对这一新作的期待达到了顶峰，Rockstar这款开放世界动作冒险系列的粉丝也用实际花费兑现了他们的热情。根据Sensor Tower汇总的数据，Rockstar仅靠预购收入就已经完成了通往10亿美元目标的四分之三。

paragraphs.en: As of November 3, an estimated 7.71 million units have been sold, translating to a whopping $751 million in profits. The split between consoles is also notable; the amount of preorders on PlayStation is significantly higher than those on Xbox, with a 74% - 26% split.
paragraphs.cn: 截至11月3日，游戏估计已售出771万份，带来了高达7.51亿美元的利润。不同主机之间的占比也值得注意：PlayStation上的预购量明显高于XBOX，比例为74%对26%。

paragraphs.en: This means that, on PlayStation, roughly $559 million in revenue was accrued; on Xbox, $192 million was made. Rockstar is making out like bandits, and the game hasn’t even come out yet.
paragraphs.cn: 这意味着，游戏在PlayStation上获得了约5.59亿美元的收入，在XBOX上则获得了1.92亿美元。Rockstar赚得盆满钵满，而游戏甚至还没有发售。

paragraphs.en: For reference, GTA 5 made $800 million in its first 24 hours , and reached $1 billion in three days , making it the fastest entertainment product to reach $1 billion in history. It's possible that GTA 6 blows past this record, given what we're already seeing, but only time will tell once November 19 actually gets here.
paragraphs.cn: 作为参考，《GTA5》在发售后的头24小时内收入达到8亿美元，三天内达到10亿美元，成为历史上最快达到10亿美元收入的娱乐产品。鉴于我们目前看到的情况，《GTA6》有可能远远打破这一纪录，但只有等到11月19日真正到来后，时间才能给出答案。

paragraphs.en: These numbers are huge, and it’s likely due to fans purchasing the $100 Ultimate Edition of the game rather than its standard version. Strauss Zelnick, the CEO of Rockstar's parent company Take-Two Interactive, said as much in an August interview with CNBC , where he theorized this trend was “a reflection of the fact that the most avid consumers are the ones who are preordering now."
paragraphs.cn: 这些数字十分惊人，这很可能是因为粉丝购买的是100美元的游戏终极版，而不是标准版。Rockstar母公司Take-Two Interactive的首席执行官Strauss Zelnick在8月接受CNBC采访时也表达了类似看法，他推测这一趋势「反映出现在预购的是最狂热的消费者」。

paragraphs.en: The Standard Edition of GTA 6 isn’t a whole lot cheaper. At $80, the base game also costs players a pretty penny — something that Zelnick told IGN was a reflection of the game’s value and actually a “bargain.”
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》标准版也没有便宜多少。基础游戏售价80美元，对玩家来说同样是一笔不小的开销。Zelnick告诉IGN，这个价格反映了游戏的价值，实际上「很划算」。

paragraphs.en: “We aim always to deliver vastly more value than what we charge,” he said. “And we think that price point allows us to do just that. And then of course we have a premium opportunity for people who want to avail themselves of that. And even that one, again, we think is priced in a way so as to deliver much more value than what we're charging,” he told us.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们的目标始终是提供远远超过收费的价值，」他说，「我们认为这个价位让我们能够做到这一点。当然，我们还为想要选择高端版本的人提供了这样的机会。同样，即便是那个版本，我们也认为它的定价能让我们提供远超收费的价值。」他告诉我们。

paragraphs.en: “The truth is that the real cost of a AAA video game is a whole lot lower today than it was 20 years ago. Pricing has not kept pace with inflation. And our goal is to continue to over-deliver for our consumers, because how you feel about any experience is the intersection of the experience itself and what you pay for it. So to say that we expect that Grand Theft Auto 6 will be an incredible bargain as experiences go is a gross understatement, because Rockstar Games is known for over-delivering.”
paragraphs.cn: 「事实上，如今一款3A电子游戏的实际成本比20年前低得多。定价没有跟上通货膨胀的步伐。我们的目标是继续为消费者提供超出预期的内容，因为你对任何一种体验的感受，取决于体验本身和你为此支付的价格。所以，如果说我们预计《GTA6》作为一种体验将物超所值，那还远远不足以形容，因为Rockstar以提供超出预期的内容而闻名。」

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 releases on November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox X|S. For more interesting stats about the game, check out IGN’s report on how many players intend to take off work on release day, or see the concerning amount of fans who would give up their pets for a month for the chance to play it a week early.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于2026年11月19日在PS5和XBOX X|S上发售。想了解更多关于这款游戏的有趣数据，可以查看IGN关于有多少玩家打算在发售当天请假的报道，或者看看有多少粉丝愿意为了提前一周玩到游戏而放弃宠物一个月，其人数令人担忧。
